Jasprit Bumrah Clears Fitness Test, Set to Play Sri Lanka Series

Fast bowler Jasprit Bumrah has successfully passed a fitness test conducted at the BCCI Center of Excellence. Following this clearance, he is now eligible to participate in the upcoming two-match Test series against Sri Lanka. His return is expected to significantly bolster the Indian team's bowling attack.
